title: Add strict Fourfold Boolean CSR to held-out multi-hop falsification
masterplan_authority: Revision 11 / Version 2.2.0 / Gate 1 — Renovation and owner-directed Genesis
finding: The existing held-out imported-type/document-consistency probe compared direct Forest, four independent relation indices, and TensorView, while the strict Fourfold Boolean CSR oracle was exercised only by the simpler relation probe. That left no held-out falsification evidence for actual typed CSR matmul/hadamard composition across the same multi-hop Fourfold subject.
primary_claim: A diagnostic-only held-out CSR arm now projects four already-authoritative relation families through boolean_relation_block_from_fourfold, composes imports→declares and documents→mentions_type with the existing Boolean semiring oracle, intersects the resulting code→type paths with the existing Hadamard operation, and checks exact equality against the existing Forest, preindexed-Forest, and TensorView answers. The CSR query path is pinned not to call iter_entries. No production contract, semantic plane, graph authority, tensor type, index, store, registry, scheduler, backend, promotion authority, or public surface is added.
gardener_decision: Extend falsification coverage around the existing strict CSR oracle rather than adding another query engine or backend. Reuse the existing held-out generator, Forest/preindexed/Tensor queries, measurement helper, workload hashes, and break-even helper through one diagnostic module; use the existing relation projection, TypedRelationBlock matmul/hadamard, and BooleanSemiring as the only CSR implementation under test.
acceptance: the held-out single-result and query-suite answers are identical across direct Forest, preindexed Forest, TensorView, and strict Fourfold Boolean CSR
the CSR arm binds the exact Forest identity and uses complete code/type/knowledge fixture planes while preserving verified Fourfold bindings
